title: Transcript event
description: One line of an agent's transcript, stored as JSON Lines: one event per line, in the order they happened. The performer appends its transcript while its attempt runs and redacts secrets before appending; the transcript is sealed when the attempt is submitted.

ts.description: When the event happened, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

kind.description: `assistant`: the agent's own text. `user`: a prompt the agent was given. `tool_call`: a tool the agent called, with its arguments as `content`. `tool_result`: what the tool returned. `note`: anything else worth keeping. `question`, `answer` and `steer`: a question the agent asked, the answer it received, and a steering note it read, as it saw them.

content.description: What the event says: text, or for a tool call or result any JSON value.

tool.description: The tool a `tool_call` or `tool_result` is about.

message.description: The Cannery Row message a `question`, `answer` or `steer` event records.

model.description: The model that produced an `assistant` event.
